backgrounds.name: Hold Veteran
backgrounds.description: Years standing watch on the freezing battlements of Valenfrost Keep against raiders and wolves.
backgrounds.dialoguePerk: Hold guards and huscarls treat you as an honorable comrade.
backgrounds.passiveBonus: Accustomed to standing firm against biting mountain blizzards.

backgrounds.name: Barrow Delver
backgrounds.description: You have plundered the sealed burial cairns of forgotten chieftains and survived the walking dead.
backgrounds.dialoguePerk: Scholars and antiquarians eagerly buy rare curiosities from your pack.
backgrounds.passiveBonus: Intuitive eye for tripwires, loose flagstones, and hidden wall alcoves.

backgrounds.name: Apprentice Runecarver
backgrounds.description: Trained under the master enchanters of Frostmere Spire in the geometry of storm and frost runes.
backgrounds.dialoguePerk: Mages of the Winter Circle welcome you into their sanctums without suspicion.
backgrounds.passiveBonus: Instinctive recognition of ancient runic inscriptions and magical wards.

backgrounds.name: Mistglen Smuggler
backgrounds.description: Piloted flat-bottomed punts through the swamp mist of Mistglen, transporting contraband under the watch of the fog.
backgrounds.dialoguePerk: Fences, thieves, and informants whisper passwords to you freely.
backgrounds.passiveBonus: Knows how to melt into marsh fog and strike deals in dingy dock taverns.
